questions.stem: Which of the following correctly describes the particles in a liquid?

options.text: Far apart and moving randomly at high speeds
Closely packed in a regular pattern, vibrating in fixed positions
Close together but irregularly arranged, able to move around each other
Fixed in position with no movement at all

questions.explanation: In a liquid, particles are close together but not in a regular arrangement. They can move around each other, which is why liquids can flow and take the shape of their container while maintaining a fixed volume.
